scripted.text: Practise on this one. It is a form about forms. File it FOR FURTHER STUDY.
scripted.subject: paperwork
scripted.note: teaches refusal; its sign side brings "another copy" back (3.1): the line is written by writer 1 in the chains-mayor batch note until format.ts has a home for a one-branch follow-up

scripted.text: Welcome, Mayor. Please sign this to say you have read it. You haven't. Sign it.
scripted.subject: paperwork
scripted.note: teaches signing; its study side brings "another copy" back (3.1), as scripted-1

scripted.text: Let Till's Teas sponsor the clock tower. It would chime TILL'S TEAS on the hour.
scripted.subject: clocks
scripted.note: pays a fixed sum (3.1); never also in a comic deck

scripted.text: A small fruit basket for you. No reason. Perhaps more ribbon-cuttings? No reason.
scripted.subject: ribbons

scripted.text: Your door says GOVERNOR. Your sandwich says PRUELLA. Welcome.
scripted.subject: paperwork
scripted.note: the governor's first paper: Pruella welcomes you, dry and hungry; teaches nothing new. Suggested effects for build-office.py (the rules'): as scripted-2 (sign every club +1; study No change), with no follow-up

scripted.text: Welcome, President. I have welcomed three. I liked one of them.
scripted.subject: paperwork
scripted.note: the president's first paper: Mildred has seen three presidents and liked one, and never says which; teaches nothing new. Suggested effects as scripted-governor

runUp.text: Judge the {district} Prize Hedge Show. Say nothing about the leaning one.
runUp.subject: hedges

runUp.text: Pop in at the {district} fête. Cuthbert's form says: four hours.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Award {district}'s best-kept bench. Do not sit on it. It is kept.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Wear the {district} fête sash: GUEST OF HONOUR (SELF-NOMINATED).
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Judge the {district} fruit show. Declare any baskets first.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Visit {district}: five minutes for you, fifteen for photographs.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Lay {district}'s first paving stone. The second says you did.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Open the {district} jumble sale. Your old hat is on table three.
runUp.subject: hats

runUp.text: Taste the {district} soup. Then pause, nod and say 'remarkable'.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Sign the {district} visitors' book. Use the whole first page.
runUp.subject: vanity

rallies.text: A rally at the fête. The scissors are on loan. Snips are counted.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: Hold a rally at the bandstand. Bring the ceremonial scissors. Cut something.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: A rally at the vegetable show. Cut the ribbon. Not the pumpkin.
rallies.subject: vegetable-shows

rallies.text: A rally at the show. Scissors up for the Drizzle. Higher. Good.
rallies.subject: ribbons
